source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-38

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic governor: remove and install
steps: Pull the governor out of the case.
Install in reverse order with a new cover gasket, then set the fluid level.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic modulator and modulator valve: remove and install
steps: Remove the modulator screw and retainer.
Pull the modulator out of the case and discard its O-ring.
Remove the modulator valve from the case.
Install in reverse order with a new O-ring on the modulator, then set the fluid level.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic parking linkage: remove and install
steps: Remove the bottom pan and strainer.
Unscrew the jam nut holding the detent lever on the manual shaft.
Pull the manual shaft retaining pin from the case.
Remove the manual shaft and jam nut; leave the manual shaft seal unless it must be replaced.
Remove the parking actuator rod and detent lever assembly.
Unscrew and remove the parking pawl bracket.
Remove the pawl return spring.
Only if parts must be replaced: remove the pawl shaft retainer, then the pawl shaft, cup plug and pawl.
Install in reverse order, using a new seal and cup plug if they were removed and a new pan gasket; set the fluid level.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic rear seal: replace
steps: Remove the propeller shaft.
Pry the seal out with a screwdriver or small chisel.
Drive in a new seal with tool J-21359.
Refit the propeller shaft.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic: other service with transmission in vehicle
parts: valve body spacer plate, gasket and check balls
notes: When done as single jobs rather than in an overhaul, these are best done with the transmission in the car (procedures in the Overhaul Manual, Transmission Disassembly and Reassembly): oil filler pipe and O-ring; oil pan and gasket; downshift solenoid or connector; valve body spacer plate, gasket and check balls; front accumulator piston; rear servo and rear accumulator; rear band apply check with tool J-21370; front servo; speedometer driven gear; case extension or gasket; strainer and O-ring.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic transmission: remove and install
steps: Before lifting the car, disconnect the negative battery cable and release the parking brake.
Put the car on a hoist and remove both exhaust pipes (Corvette).
Remove the propeller shaft.
Disconnect the speedometer cable, the lead to the case connector, the modulator vacuum line and the oil cooler pipes.
Disconnect the shift control linkage.
Support the transmission on a transmission jack.
Unhook the rear mount from the frame crossmember.
Remove the two bolts at each end of the crossmember, plus (on Corvette) the through bolt inside the frame and the parking brake pulley; take out the crossmember.
Remove the oil cooler lines, modulator vacuum line, speedometer cable and detent solenoid wire at the transmission.
Remove the converter under pan.
Remove the converter-to-flywheel bolts.
Lower the transmission until the jack is just carrying it.
Remove the transmission-to-engine bolts and the oil filler tube at the transmission.
Raise the transmission back to its normal height, support the engine on a jack, slide the transmission back off the engine and lower it out.
notes: Caution: hold the converter with tool J-5384 while lowering, or keep the rear of the transmission lower than the front, so the converter does not fall out.
Steps for Camaro (parking brake cables, reinforcement plate, left exhaust pipe) and the exhaust bolt loosening for Chevrolet and Chevelle are omitted.
